deviations.title: the variance decision — the i.i.d. audit → the conservative amendment OR the rendered caveat

signingConsequence: with all five signed + IN2/IN4/AF4 discharged + the push decision, the invites go out against a goalpost already set. Until then the sprint terminates READY-PENDING-OPERATOR (or an honest STOP with the remainder quoted).
